card.name: Linking words in cooking and recipe text
card.fires_on: Small linking words and dashes (such as by, and, to, that, their) right after a cooking, cookbook or chef reference, especially before a chef's name or a kitchen word. Also dashes after cook quotes before the speaker's name.

modes.label: Dash after cook quote
modes.description: The dash that introduces the speaker's name after a quote about cooking or recipes.
modes.example: "Cooking is like love. It should be entered into with abandon or not at all."<< ->> Harriet Van Horne

modes.label: Link word after cookbook or chef
modes.description: Words like by, and, to following a cookbook title or culinary figure, leading to an author or chef name.
modes.example: The Fifth Taste: Cooking With Umami<< by>> David and Anna Kasabian

card.writes: It pushes the model toward kitchen, cooking, culinary and chef words coming next.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in food writing where a cook, cookbook or kitchen topic is about to continue.
